evidence.observedFact: The active business page describes an esthetics and nail salon suite offering nail, skincare, massage and spray-tanning services and publishes a 50% cancellation fee with a request that clients notify the business to reschedule.
The current contact page lists operating hours at 9160 Mentor Ave, Suite 106 & 107, and routes customer questions through a web form that the page says will be received by email.

gaps.recommendedFix: Demonstrate cancellation recovery, rebooking prompts and repeat-service workflows around the existing appointment policy.
Demonstrate structured inquiry follow-up and conversion tracking around the existing form-to-email workflow.

notes: The cancellation policy is an observed fact. The follow-up opportunity is a hypothesis based on the publicly visible form-to-email workflow and is not proof that inquiries are currently mishandled. No monetary loss is claimed.
